_about: Quick check settings for RAYDAR 2.7. Most rules are NOT kept here: RAYDAR reads them from each study's own eSource questions every time a file loads,
e.g. 'Have you been diagnosed with a form of diabetes?' answered 'No - Exclude' means the study needs type 2 diabetes.
conditions: the conditions Quick check can ask about. A condition only shows on Quick check when at least one loaded study has a rule for it.
key: short id, never change it once used. label: what the recruiter sees. match: words (a regular expression) that find the condition in an eSource question.
answer / answerNot (optional): when one question covers several kinds, e.g. 'Yes, type 2' versus 'Yes, type 1', which answers mean this condition and which mean another.
sex (optional): only ask this sex (m or f).

rules: rules the eSource questions don't spell out, each with the eSource wording it comes from. item is a condition key, 'smoke' or 'meds'; when is the Quick check answer (y or n); result is 'no' (rules the study out) or 'check'.
ignore: rules RAYDAR read from the eSource that turned out wrong. Give the file and the question name, and optionally the item.
After editing, run npm run build:single, or load this file with Tools > Study files to try it in the open tab.
